recentItems.title: Saxony-Anhalt elections: Germany's far-right AFD on track to secure majority
recentItems.description:
Voters in Germany’s Saxony-Anhalt head to the polls Sunday, with the far-right AfD leading in opinion polls. The party vows to prioritise German culture and reverse policies established after World War II.

Al Jazeera’s Dominic Kane reports.

recentItems.title: Two trapped workers rescued in Nepal: Teams pull men from tunnel nine days after flood
recentItems.description:
Two workers have been rescued alive from a hydropower tunnel in Nepal, nine days after devastating floods. Rescue teams continue searching for dozens trapped underground amid massive debris, while thousands remain missing across the country.

Al Jazeera’s Jessica Washington reports.

recentItems.title: Falkland sovereignty dispute: Argentina to sanction firms linked to oil projects
recentItems.description:
Argentina’s President Javier MilAY has put the long-running dispute over the Malvinas — or Falkland Islands — back at the centre of the country’s political agenda. 
During a national televised address, Milei announced plans to strengthen sanctions against companies involved in exploiting natural resources around the British-controlled islands. 

Al Jazeera’s Teresa Bo reports.

recentItems.title: No shelter or water, yet Lebanese return home, defying Israel.
recentItems.description:
